# Do distrustSeconds and a longer forecast cut opening damage from elite pests?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | movement |
| Result | confirmed |
| Created | L2.I4 |
| Updated | L2.I7 |

## Hypothesis

distrustSeconds 10 and forecastSeconds 1.0 make the action model check steps after a hit the forecast called free and look further ahead, so seeker-sprouts takes less damage before 1:30 and survives the Fry Fly and Cave Grub openings on seeds 32 and 33.

## Method

Fresh seeker-sprouts, 300 s, seeds 33 and 32 from 0:00, default playbook except those two knobs. Compare with baselines L2.I1.G3 (seed 33, died 0:52) and L2.I1.G2 (seed 32, died 3:08), and the L2.I3 low-health arm. Read damage taken by 1:30, model-asked moves and death time. Add seed 31 later.

## Findings

Four of five paired seeds favour the knobs (3:05 against 0:52, 5:00 against 3:08, 5:00 against 3:23, 5:00 against 3:16), while seed 35 went the other way (died 2:39 against baseline 5:00 with 8 chests). Knobs lived 5:00 on 3 of 5 against 1 of 5. Still in the playbook; a large share of the variance is chest and evolution timing.
